data.name: Kona Luxury Dolphin Snorkel Sail
data.headline: 4 Hours • Kona Coast Snorkel & Dolphin Cruise • Lunch Included
data.description:
Discover the beauty of Kona’s coastline aboard No Wiki, a spacious and comfortable sailing catamaran designed for relaxation and adventure. Cruise past rugged lava cliffs and turquoise coves while keeping an eye out for pods of Hawaiian spinner dolphins and other marine life.

Your captain will select the best snorkel sites based on the day’s ocean conditions, which may include Pawai Bay — known for its sea caves, arches, and swim-throughs — or the crystal-clear waters off Makalawena, often called one of the island’s most beautiful beaches.

After your snorkel, relax on board with a fresh sandwich-style lunch and light snacks as you soak in the views of the coastline and mountains beyond. With expert crew, quality gear, and true island hospitality, this is an unforgettable way to experience Kona by sea.

highlight_box.title: Kona Luxury Dolphin Snorkel Sail
highlight_box.description: Set out from Honokōhau Harbor aboard No Wiki for a 4-hour adventure along the Kona Coast. Spot wild spinner dolphins, snorkel pristine reefs like Pawai Bay or Makalawena, and enjoy lunch onboard.

data.highlights:
- Cruise the stunning Kona Coast aboard No Wiki, a 51-foot Lagoon sailing catamaran

- Snorkel at two of the Big Island’s most beautiful reefs — such as Pawai Bay or Makalawena

- Spot Hawaiian spinner dolphins, green sea turtles, and colorful tropical fish

- Enjoy a fresh sandwich-style lunch and light snacks on board

- All snorkel gear provided, with in-water assistance from your expert crew

- Spacious, comfortable sailing experience with shaded seating and panoramic views
data.itinerary:
- Check-In: Arrive 20 minutes prior to departure (by 8:40 AM) at Honokōhau Harbor. Meet your captain and crew, and get fitted with snorkel gear before boarding No Wiki.

- Departure: Set sail along the scenic Kona Coast, enjoying panoramic views and watching for Hawaiian spinner dolphins, turtles, and other marine life.

- Snorkel Stop: The captain will choose the day’s best sites, which may include Pawai Bay’s sea caves and arches or Makalawena’s pristine reef. Crew members provide in-water assistance and guidance.

- Lunch & Relaxation: After snorkeling, enjoy a fresh sandwich-style lunch and light snacks on deck as you relax in the sun or shade and take in the coastal views.

- Return: Sail back toward Honokōhau Harbor, soaking in the breeze and ocean views for a picture-perfect finish to your Kona adventure.

meeting_point.address: Honokohau Harbor, Slip 38 - 352-429 Kealakehe Pkwy, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740

data.what_is_included:
- 4-hour sailing and snorkel cruise along the Kona Coast

- Snorkel gear provided (sanitized reusable mask, snorkel, fins, and vest)

- Sandwich-style lunch and light snacks served on board

- Non-alcoholic beverages: soda, juice, and water

- Friendly, knowledgeable captain and crew offering in-water guidance

- Comfortable shaded seating, open decks, and restrooms on board
data.what_is_not_included:
- Transportation
- A 20% tip for the crew is customary and greatly appreciated if you enjoyed your experience. For your convenience, gratuity can be added to your booking at check-out.
data.what_to_bring:
Swimsuit and towel

- Reef-safe sunscreen (no sprays, please apply before boarding)

- Sunglasses and a hat for sun protection

- Reusable water bottle (we provide refills on board to reduce plastic waste)

- Light cover-up or jacket for the return sail

- Optional: Camera or waterproof phone case for photos and videos — don’t forget to tag us @HawaiiNautical!

data.faqs:
- **Do I need snorkeling experience?**
*No experience is required! Our friendly crew provides guidance and in-water assistance, making this trip great for all skill levels and ages.*

- **Are snorkeling gear and flotation provided?**
*Yes. Sanitized reusable masks, snorkels, fins, and vests are provided on board at no extra charge.*

- **Are food and drinks included?**
*Yes. Enjoy a fresh sandwich-style lunch, light snacks, and complimentary non-alcoholic beverages such as soda, juice, and water.*

- **Can children join the tour?**
*Absolutely! This sail is family-friendly and safe for all ages. Life jackets are provided for everyone.*

- **Will we see dolphins?**
*Spinner dolphins are commonly seen along the Kona Coast, though sightings can’t be guaranteed as they are wild animals.*

- **Where does the tour depart from?**
*We depart from Honokōhau Harbor in Kailua-Kona. Look for the No Wiki catamaran near the “Check-In” sign by the harbor walkway.*

- **What time should I arrive?**
*Please check in 20 minutes before departure (by 8:40 AM) to allow time for gear fitting and boarding.*

- **Is parking available?**
*Yes. Free parking is available at Honokōhau Harbor. We recommend arriving early and not leaving valuables in your vehicle.*

- **What should I bring?**
*Bring a swimsuit, towel, reef-safe sunscreen, sunglasses, and a reusable water bottle. Optional: camera or waterproof phone case for photos.*

- **What if I get seasick?**
*No Wiki is a large, stable Lagoon catamaran designed for a smooth ride. If you’re prone to motion sickness, we recommend taking precautions before departure.*
